mutants.description: Disable the shared public no-sparse gate. The two public Print/G-code rows must then lose the tower extrusion reduction while retaining lower and upper tool changes, so the reduction and compacted-plan assertions fail.

Disable the type2 integration branch that omits sparse tool-change results. The public true row should then retain sparse tower G1 XY/E paths and fail the measured reduction while the source remains compile-safe.
